customApp.categoryHelp: Select the most relevant category for this app. This helps with visual organization and filtering.
customApp.iconHelp: Pick an icon shown on the app card.
customApp.noPorts: No port mappings — the app won't be accessible from a browser.
customApp.portsHint: Host ports should be in the 8600+ range. Custom apps get ports starting at {{port}}.
customApp.noVolumes: No volumes — data won't persist across restarts.
customApp.limitsHint: Caps prevent a runaway container from starving the host. Leave blank to use the defaults (1024 MB / 1 CPU).
customApp.boundBy: Currently bound by: {{usedBy}}. Installation may fail.
customApp.restartNote: Containers are created with --restart=unless-stopped. Data is not persisted unless you add volume mounts above.

urlModal.title: Set Custom URL
urlModal.description: Set where {{name}} opens from — useful if you reach it through a reverse proxy or local DNS. Leave this empty to use the default address ({{address}}).
urlModal.label: Custom URL
urlModal.invalid: Enter a valid http(s) address (e.g. https://jellyfin.myhomelab.net). A bare host like "jellyfin.lan" becomes http://jellyfin.lan.
